resolutions.researcher_notes: DISAGREEMENT, not a dead end -- flagging rather than citing per standing rule 2/'never propose refs for a different value'. GEM records StartLocation='Kit Carson' (CO) / EndLocation='Sherman' (KS). I opened three independent sources and none supports these as the pipeline's actual termini: (1) the FERC Final EIS (already on this row's Diameter/Length/Fuel refs, federalregister.gov/documents/2004/02/26/E4-412) describes the route running west-to-east through Weld, Morgan, Washington, Yuma, then KIT CARSON county (Colorado, 189.0 mi) and continuing through SHERMAN, Wallace, Logan, Scott, Lane, Finney, Hodgeman, Ford, then Kiowa county (Kansas, 190.8 mi) -- Kit Carson and Sherman are the two counties straddling the CO/KS state line, i.e. roughly the MIDPOINT of the 379.8-mile mainline, not either end; the same EIS places the actual receipt points at the Cheyenne Hub in Weld County, CO and the delivery points in Kiowa County, KS (plus secondary deliveries in Scott/Ford). (2) Kinder Morgan's current operations page (kindermorgan.com/pages/business/gas_pipelines/west/CheyennePlains, fetched this session) states the system 'extends from near the Wyoming-Colorado border to South Central Kansas.' (3) industrialinfo.com (fetched this session) independently names the specific towns: the pipeline is 'originating in the Cheyenne Hub area of northern Colorado, near Greeley, and terminating near Greensburg, Kansas' -- Greensburg is the Kiowa County seat, consistent with the EIS's Kiowa County delivery points. All three sources -- a FERC primary filing, the operator's own current page, and independent trade press -- agree with EACH OTHER and disagree with the recorded Kit Carson/Sherman pair. This reads as a genuine Location correction candidate (StartLocation ~ Cheyenne Hub, Weld County, CO; EndLocation ~ Greensburg, Kiowa County, KS, or the Kiowa County delivery-point cluster) for a separate Update pass, not a ref-sweep fill -- not citing any of the three as support for the recorded Kit Carson/Sherman values. This exact contradiction was already independently identified and flagged as an open validity concern on this row (batches/united-states-gas/staging/deepsweep-west-operating/rows/P0166.json, validity[2], verdict=concern) before this recovery pass; I re-verified two of its three cited sources live this session (kindermorgan.com and industrialinfo.com both returned 200 and matched the quoted claims) rather than merely restating the prior finding.

DISAGREEMENT, not a dead end -- flagging rather than citing per standing rule 2/'never propose refs for a different value'. GEM records Owner1='El Paso Corp' at 100.00%. I opened three sources this session and none supports El Paso Corp as the CURRENT owner: (1) Kinder Morgan Inc.'s FY2025 Form 10-K, Exhibit 21.1 (Subsidiaries of the Registrant), sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1506307/000150630726000011/kmi-2025x10kxexh211.htm -- required a SEC fair-access User-Agent (a plain browser UA 403s; a UA with a contact identifier per SEC's bot policy returns 200) -- lists 'Cheyenne Plains Gas Pipeline Company, L.L.C.' (Delaware) among current KMI subsidiaries with no minority-interest percentage shown, i.e. wholly owned by Kinder Morgan, Inc. today. (2) offshore-technology.com/marketdata/cheyenne-plains-gas-gas-pipeline-the-us/ states in its main body 'The Cheyenne Plains Gas project ... is owned by Kinder Morgan' (note: the same page's separate 'About' boilerplate elsewhere still says 'a wholly owned subsidiary of Elpaso Corporation' -- an internal inconsistency that is itself evidence the El Paso attribution is stale copy carried over from an old profile, not a live fact). (3) Kinder Morgan's own 2012 investor-relations press release (ir.kindermorgan.com/news/news-details/2012/El-Paso-Pipeline-Partners-Agrees-to-Acquire-Cheyenne-Plains-Pipeline-...) confirms El Paso Corp WAS the seller/prior owner: 'it has agreed to acquire ... all of Cheyenne Plains Investment Company, L.L.C., which owns Cheyenne Plains Gas Pipeline Company, L.L.C. from El Paso Corporation' -- i.e. El Paso Corp's ownership ended with this 2012 sale to (Kinder-Morgan-affiliated) El Paso Pipeline Partners, and El Paso Corp itself ceased to exist as an independent entity when Kinder Morgan, Inc. completed its acquisition of El Paso Corporation on 2012-05-24. So the recorded value was accurate pre-2012 and has been stale for roughly 14 years; the current, sourceable owner is Kinder Morgan, Inc. (Owner1% would stay 100.00%). This is a genuine Owner correction candidate for a separate Update pass, not a ref-sweep fill -- not citing any of these three as support for the recorded 'El Paso Corp' value. This exact contradiction was already independently identified and flagged as an open validity concern on this row (batches/united-states-gas/staging/deepsweep-west-operating/rows/P0166.json, validity[1], verdict=concern, contested Owner1->'Kinder Morgan, Inc.') before this recovery pass, including the same three-source basis; I re-verified all three live this session rather than merely restating the prior finding, and separately confirmed the 2012 KMI/El Paso Corp merger completion date via that same press release context.
